note: Checklist granularity: each {{Checklist}} block covers one physical sub-trip. Bank withdraw lists name every item and quantity before movement begins, e.g. "withdraw Knife, Jug of Water, Bronze Axe, Tinderbox, Leather Gloves, 5 wines, 1 log". This is the atomic step unit.

Following [[Boots of lightness]] link leads to Obtaining section confirming spawn location, required light source and slash weapon, 60s respawn, world-hop method. No NPC or GE purchase needed. Item pages Obtaining section = canonical source-of-truth for non-traded drops/spawns.

Quest quick guide breadcrumb: X Marks the Spot/Quick guide section 2 contains its own {{Checklist}} with exact dig tile descriptions and gallery references (images by clue number). Following the /Quick guide subpage instead of the main quest page yields the tightest step granularity without full quest prose noise.

Long-horizon passives: the guide uses a "Passive" prefix for concurrent background tasks that have no urgency deadline. Examples: "Passive - Gemstone Crab Unlocked for 90+ Combats", "Passive - Start Herb Runs", "Passive - Wilderness Agility to 72". Each passive notes the unlock condition and the ultimate target level/item, letting the player layer background grinds without blocking the main path.

note: Checklist step grammar: verb + named target + exact quantity/threshold + parenthetical constraint. Example grain: sell one cake at a time, need 260+ gp total.
Sell-quantity economics: guide says sell 1 cake at a time (not 5/10/50) to maximize GP. Shop page StoreTableHead buymultiplier field explains why — store buy price degrades as stock fills.

Toggle states appear inline within other action steps, never as standalone bullets. E.g. chop trees with asterisk-annotation *Endless Harvest toggle autobank on*. Guide renderer must handle embedded state changes.

{{DPLTaskRow|name|desc|s={{SCP|skill|level}}|other=items|tier=easy/medium/hard/elite|region=|pactTask=yes|id=N}} — structured task index. s= field is skill gate, other= is item requirements, tier= is point value, id= is numeric task ID for deep-linking.

{{StoreLine|name=item|stock=N|restock=N}} + {{StoreTableHead|sellmultiplier=N|buymultiplier=N}} — shop page templates. sellmultiplier=player buy price %, buymultiplier=store pays player %. Toci Gem Store: buymultiplier=700, explains guide 7x GP claim.

{{Map|mapID=-1|title=...|x,y|mtype=pin}} and {{Map|...|x:NNNN,y:NNNN|mtype=pin}} — two coordinate formats seen. Fairy ring page uses bare x,y; Quetzal page uses named x:N,y:N. Both yield map tile pin at exact world coords.

Transport breadcrumb: guide says fairy ring to Aldarin (CKQ). Verified path: Aldarin page Transportation section shows Fairycode CKQ. Fairy ring page C-combinations table shows CKQ with Map pin at x:1359,y:2941.

Shop breadcrumb: guide says buy Knife at Fortis General Store. Verified: StoreLine name=Knife stock=5 restock=20. sellmultiplier=1300 means player buys at 130% base price. Location page Civitas Shops section lists the store by wikilink.

Quetzal transport breadcrumb: guide says bird to Auburnvale. Verified: Quetzal Transport System Locations table shows Auburnvale at x:1410,y:3363 as a built-by-default landing site. Same table covers all 14 sites.

Conditional branching uses parenthetical skip labels with relic names, not separate guide paths. Format: (Can skip if not Woodsman). Branching depth is one level; no nested branches seen. Relic-gated steps cluster into labeled subsections.
{{DiarySkillStats|skill=level|...}} at end of guide shows target skill levels for guide completion. E.g. Hunter=91, Crafting=70. Useful as prerequisite gate summary for guide-chain planning.

{{Colour|Red|...}} is a signal template, not data. Red text marks economy-critical rules or hard constraints in guide steps (e.g. inventory coin count matters). These must be preserved as hard constraints, not soft tips, in a guide renderer.
Checklist blocks use {{Checklist|title=<hub>|...}} where title is a location/phase label; all steps within a hub share the same bank loadout context
Buy-list steps tag exact shop + itemized quantities + running GP cost in one bullet, e.g. buy-block then a parenthetical cumulative total after each sell/buy loop

Quests are resumed across 3+ non-adjacent bullets using Start/Continue/Complete verbs, each Continue bullet gated on a named travel trigger (until you need to go to Rimmington) rather than a vague amount-done marker
Minigame teleports (Bounty Hunter, Ferox, Soul Wars, NMZ, Giants Foundry, Sorceress Garden) are used purely as free fast-travel shorthand, unrelated to the minigame itself

NPC shop stock+restock lives on the NPC page Stock section via StoreTableHead/StoreLine(name,stock,restock); verified on Louie Legs and Betty's Magic Emporium, both plain wikitables of exact per-item starting stock

Exact dialogue-option + NPC-tile walkthrough for a quest lives on <Quest>/Quick guide Walkthrough section, not the base quest page; base quest page Walkthrough is narrative prose with the same content, confirmed by diffing Client of Kourend vs Client of Kourend/Quick guide

Quest prerequisites, exact required items with substitution notes, and per-destination fastest-travel options (each with a GP-costed alternative) live in the base quest page Details section inside {{Quest details|requirements=|items=|recommended=}}

{{Map|x=|y=|squareX=|squareY=|mtype=square|polygon|pin}} yields three coordinate precisions: square+squareX/Y for a coarse map-square grid ref, polygon for an exact walkable area boundary, pin for one precise landing tile; caption often nests a {{Chat option}} for that exact NPC
